protocol.data_metric: Equal fixation mean of P1 mean-three-vertex SSE + P4 mean-three-vertex SSE in centered camera coordinates.
protocol.anchors: Only arithmetic fixation-mean anchors; gaze nominal labels and A_ref. Residual scale 1 px.
protocol.bounds_interpretation: Operational ranges, not framewise priors or calibration truth. Forward fitting does not restrict measured inverse-domain validity; failures are reported.
protocol.frozen: References/origin, P1/P4 keystone, beta/A_ref, vertical gaze, units, correspondence, population.
protocol.magnification: Positive P1 profiled magnification recomputed at every trial gaze; shared by P4.
protocol.A0: Exact saved Stage04 A states/gaze/M, not refitted under new objective.
protocol.conditioning_units: Raw singular values/condition use degrees and diopters; normalized column correlations/angles are unit invariant.
